rules.statement: IMB/FVG is price inefficiency around an impulsive move represented by the gap between the wick/extreme of the candle before the impulse and the wick/extreme of the candle after it.
Bullish IMB zone runs from the previous candle high to the post-impulse candle low; bearish IMB runs from the previous candle low to the post-impulse candle high.
Equilibrium is the exact 0.5 midpoint of the Imbalance zone.
Full Fill is complete coverage of the price inefficiency zone.

SOURCE describes IMB as a price magnet and says price seeks equilibrium/full fill. PURE_SOURCE object formation does not convert that descriptive language into a guaranteed future target or admission filter.
OTE is the retracement zone between 0.705 and 0.79 of a valid impulse.
0.5 is equilibrium/fair price; Premium/Discount analysis is relative to an already-defined source range/impulse.
Exact touch between outer candle wicks has zero zone width and is not emitted as IMB; a strictly positive wick gap is required.
Because the third-candle high/low defines one IMB boundary, the stable zone is emitted only after that candle closes; intrabar future mutation cannot rewrite the object.
Stage 5 never chooses OTE anchors from arbitrary highs/lows. It consumes an already source-qualified impulse with causal endpoints and provenance.
Premium/Discount classification is computed only after a source-qualified dealing range is known; Stage 5 does not invent range endpoints.

deferred: automatic source impulse-anchor selection when source geometry is ambiguous
forbidden_as_source: minimum FVG size in ATR/percent/ticks unless explicitly classified as research parameter
future fill status in IMB object identity
